notes.title: The newest adventure of Desktop Explorer
notes.content:
[b]Hey there, Explorers![/b]

It’s us, the devs from Recurring Dream. We’ve got some cool news to share about what’s next for [i]Desktop Explorer[/i]!

First off, a [i]huge[/i] thank you to everyone who’s checked out the demo, shared feedback, and chatted with us. Your support means the world to us and keeps us motivated every single day 💾❤️

We’re now deep in dev mode, working hard to make the game the best it can be. That means polishing what’s there, adding new gameplay features, puzzling more puzzles and getting a shiny new demo ready in the near future!

To help us focus on that next phase, we’ll be temporarily taking the current demo down from Steam. This helps us avoid confusion between versions and gives us room to make the new one extra special.

We know some of you may still want to check out the demo before it goes offline — you’ll have until May 25 at 10 am PST to add it to your library. After that, it’ll be retired until the new version is ready to be explored 🥁[b]*durum tsss*[/b].

Thanks again for all the love and support. We can’t wait to show you what we’ve been cooking up!
